title: Expired shares continue granting document access
expected: Shares grant access only while unrevoked and before expires_at (app/README.md).
observed: An initially valid persisted share was expired through authorized fixture setup; recipient still received HTTP 200 and the complete document.
reproduction: Run python evidence/reproduce.py against the preserved original source in an isolated workspace copy.
Observe expiry: baseline 200; after expiry 200 with document_returned=true.
preconditions: Authenticated same-tenant recipient has a previously valid, now expired, unrevoked share.
uncertainty: Demonstrated only against local synthetic instances; deployment and real data impact were not assessed.
impact: Confidentiality exposure continues beyond the owner-selected access window.
remediation: Applied strict current-time comparison in share read authorization; expired access retested as 404 while owner and live shares remain valid.
